name: eBay Partner Network
description: Official eBay Browse API integration for discovering physical products and returning commissionable eBay Partner Network item URLs.

credential_fields.name: client_id
credential_fields.label: eBay client ID
credential_fields.description: Production App ID from the eBay Developer Program keyset.

credential_fields.name: client_secret
credential_fields.label: eBay client secret
credential_fields.description: Production Cert ID from the same eBay keyset.

credential_fields.name: campaign_id
credential_fields.label: EPN campaign ID
credential_fields.description: The 10-digit campaign ID from eBay Partner Network. It is required for itemAffiliateWebUrl to be returned.

credential_fields.name: marketplace_id
credential_fields.label: Marketplace ID
credential_fields.description: eBay marketplace, for example EBAY_ES, EBAY_DE, EBAY_GB, or EBAY_US.

credential_fields.name: delivery_country
credential_fields.label: Delivery country
credential_fields.description: Domestic ISO alpha-2 delivery country matching the marketplace, for example ES, DE, GB, or US.

tools.name: products_search
tools.description: Search live fixed-price eBay items that ship domestically in the configured marketplace. Results include itemAffiliateWebUrl when the EPN campaign is valid.

gtin.description: UPC, EAN, ISBN, or other GTIN.

aspect_filter.description: Browse aspect filter, for example categoryId:9355,Brand:{Apple}.

tools.name: product_get
tools.description: Get complete details for a Browse item ID, including price, availability, images, seller, shipping, return terms, and the EPN affiliate URL.

tools.name: product_get_by_legacy_id
tools.description: Resolve a legacy eBay listing ID to current Browse item details and an EPN affiliate URL.
